intro.title: Subsets
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that generates all possible subsets of a given array of numbers. You will learn the core concept of backtracking, a technique for exploring all combinations by building, testing, and undoing choices. The main constructs involved include recursion, array manipulation, and state management. This beginner-friendly lesson will guide you step-by-step through the logic and implementation in JavaScript.
intro.usecase: The subsets algorithm is essential for generating all possible combinations in real-world applications like e-commerce filtering systems. When users select multiple filters (size, color, brand), the algorithm can generate all valid filter combinations to display matching products. It's also used in permission management systems to calculate all possible user access level combinations from available permissions. In data analysis dashboards, subsets help explore all possible data dimension combinations for multi-faceted reporting.
